tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (3 Drones) 1

Then all three drones move north for 89m, and next move east for 92m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 89m, then east 92m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 3, Drone 7, Drone 4: take off reaching 19 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (448, 534, 19), (891, 530, 19), and (602, 655, 19) respectively, then proceed north for 89m and subsequently east for 92m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.
